This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code) for this repository: a Rust Titan Exchange WebSocket client library plus CLI, supporting quote streams, one-shot prices, reconnection/backoff, stream queuing, and Solana instruction extraction.

Commands:
```sh
cargo build --release
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- --help
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- info
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- price SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- stream SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- swap --keypair ~/.config/solana/id.json SOL USDC 100000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- watch
cargo test --test [name]
cargo clippy --all-targets
```

`TitanClient` is thread-safe (`Arc` internally), stores `TitanConfig`, owns the WebSocket, and manages streams. A background Tokio task dispatches messages and reconnects exponentially. `StreamManager` queues requests when `concurrentStreams` is full. Each stream slot uses shared `Arc<AtomicBool>` `slot_released` so exactly one path (`stop()`/`Drop`, `StreamEnd`, or reconnect failure) decrements `active_count`; `ResumableStream.on_end` bridges server endings to queue accounting. Reconnection updates `effective_stream_id: Arc<AtomicU32>` so `QuoteStream` stops the remapped ID.

Files: `src/lib.rs` entry/re-exports; `client.rs` API; `config.rs` builder; `connection.rs` WebSocket, keepalive, resumption; `error.rs` `TitanClientError`; `state.rs` connection state/observer; `stream.rs` `QuoteStream`; `queue.rs` limiter/queue; `instructions.rs` Solana conversion/ALT fetching (feature `solana`); `tls.rs` TLS builders; `bin/titan_cli.rs` CLI.

Environment: `TITAN_URL` (CLI default `wss://us1.api.demo.titan.exchange/api/v1/ws`; library default `wss://api.titan.ag/api/v1/ws`), `TITAN_TOKEN` (required), `SOLANA_RPC_URL` (default `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com`), `TITAN_DANGER_ACCEPT_INVALID_CERTS` (dev only).

Config defaults: token required; max reconnect delay 30,000 ms; reconnect attempts infinite; `auto_wrap_sol=false`; invalid certs false; `one_shot_timeout_ms=10,000`; ping/pong use connection defaults.

API includes `new_swap_quote_stream`, `get_swap_price`, `get_swap_price_simple`, `get_info`, `get_venues`, `list_providers`, state/receiver/connectivity methods, `close`, `is_closed`, active/queued counts, and `TitanInstructions::{prepare_instructions,fetch_address_lookup_tables,convert_instructions,convert_instruction}`.

The streaming endpoint may send initial `SwapQuotes` frames with empty `quotes` vector before real data arrives, especially with dummy user pubkeys. Tests should not assert `!quotes.quotes.is_empty()` unless using a real wallet address.

Shared axum state:
```rust
pub struct WorkerServiceState {
pub titan_client: Arc<TitanClient>,
```

**Maximum file size: ~200 lines** - Split larger files  
**mod.rs files should be empty** - Only contain mod declarations, move content to meaningful file names  
Use helper structs with static methods for clear separation (e.g., `TitanHelper::method()`)  
Single error enum for the crate (`TitanClientError`)  
All fallible operations return `Result`  
**Never panic** - Always propagate errors via Result  
Use typed variants for recoverable errors (auth, rate limit), anyhow for unexpected  
Use native `async fn` directly  
No boxed futures or `async-trait` unless absolutely necessary  
Tokio-only (no runtime-agnostic abstractions)  
Use `pub` everywhere for simplicity  
Use `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]` on public methods  
**No inline log statements** - Spans provide enough context  
Remove `println!`, `dbg!`, and most `tracing::info!` statements  
Keep only `tracing::error!` and `tracing::warn!` for critical issues  
Minimal doc comments; document only non-obvious behavior; self-documenting names/types. Centralize constants; remove magic numbers.

Features: `solana` default yes; `cli` default no. docs.rs uses `default-features = false`. Dependencies include titan codec/types, Tokio, tungstenite, rustls, futures/tokio utilities, serde/rmp, thiserror/anyhow, Solana SDK/client/ALT interface, clap, dotenvy, bs58, tokio-stream, tracing-subscriber.

See `FOR_USER.md` for architecture and pitfalls.
